content.about: Moldova is a small, landlocked country between Romania and Ukraine. It has gentle hills, rich black soil and many vineyards. Wine is central to its culture. Orheiul Vechi has a monastery carved into a limestone cliff.

standout.text: Moldova's Mileștii Mici has one of the largest wine collections in the world, in tunnels underground.

didYouKnow: Mileștii Mici's wine cellars stretch for about 200 km.
Moldova is one of the least visited countries in Europe.
